events.title: Sally Beauty Gears Up to Report Q2 Earnings: What's in the Offing?
events.body: SBH is set to report Q2 results, with sales seen edging higher as resilient hair color demand and LCOD support traffic, even as earnings may dip year over year.

events.title: Tecnoglass (TGLS) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: Tecnoglass (TGLS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +8.33% and +2.47%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: 3 Apparel Stocks With the Right Setup to Beat Earnings This Season
events.body: FIGS, GAP and CPRI enter the earnings season with strong momentum, margin discipline and positive ESPs, signaling potential earnings surprises.
